about: Tata Steel Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of steel products in India and internationally. It offers reinforcement bars (rebars) and wire rods, cut-and-bend reinforcement bars, welded wire mesh, prefabricated cages (pre-cages), steel couplers and carpet reinforcement; hot-rolled, cold rolled, coated coil, tubes, rebar, wire rods; and metallic coated, pre-finished steels, alloy steels, and profiles and construction systems.
